title: Podplane OIDC config
description: Configuration for a Truster server deployment managed by Podplane.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for editor validation and completion. Podplane writes a local relative path so config editing works offline.

hostname.description: Hostname for the OIDC issuer. Podplane serves the issuer at https://<hostname>.

truster.description: Truster configuration, passed unchanged to the Truster module as truster_config. The creation wizard registers the first cluster's client and defaults its redirect URI to http://localhost:8000/callback. Podplane sets issuer_url, http_listen_addr, serving_certificate, and secrets.provider from the deployment. See https://truster.dev/docs/config/ for every option.

secrets.description: Secrets Truster loads at startup. Podplane sets the secrets provider from oidc.provider: AWS Secrets Manager ARNs on aws, or Secret Manager versions such as projects/<project>/secrets/<secret>/versions/latest on google.

kind.description: Cloud provider used to deploy Truster.

account.description: Provider account identifier, such as an AWS account ID.

project.description: Google Cloud project ID. Required for google.

zone.description: Google Cloud zone for the Truster instance, within region. Required for google.
DNS zone for the OIDC hostname.

kind.description: DNS provider used for managed OIDC DNS records: aws for Route 53 or google for Cloud DNS. Must match the OIDC provider kind.

hosted_zone_id.description: Route 53 hosted zone ID for aws. Optional; the zone is looked up by name when omitted.

hosted_zone_name.description: Cloud DNS managed zone name for google. Required for google managed DNS.
